content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Post Graduate/Master's Degree in Mass Communications/Public Relations/Journalism/Advertising/Media or any in related field Experience: Minimum 10 years' experience in handling Media/Public Relations/Branding Communications/social media/business development in a company of repute at Senior Level; proven record of achievements/Brand Promotions Age limit: Maximum 45 years Other conditions: Proficient in both written and verbal communication in English and Hindi Well informed about updates in Media/Communication Industry Good network with relevant persons/companies Ability to work independently and as part of a team

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely on contract basis through manpower agency Initially for three months, which can be extended as per requirement of the Trust

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NBT India Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online through the National Book Trust, India website www.nbtindia.gov.in. Submit the application by 07.12.2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: National Book Trust, India reserves the right not to fill up the post as advertised, if circumstances so warrant Only candidates who fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria may apply
